verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in FastAPI Swagger documentation surface at /docs on a self-hosted instance, but it is only available with ENV=dev and the API reference is labelled experimental. The probe found no vendor-hosted spec: every candidate openapi.json/swagger.json path on the docs site returned 404. missing for 10: an explicitly documented downloadable openapi.json, availability without dev mode, a vendor-hosted spec, a stable non-experimental API reference, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
Access detailed API documentation for different services provided by Open WebUI
